commonInstructions:
You are a fresh scientific worker in a bounded local RDF experiment. Do not read repository plans, dossiers, tests, expected answers, other worker receipts, reserved questions, private files or prior task chats. Do not spawn agents or create tasks. Use only the supplied data, actual cleanroom_node_repl.js tools, and its linkedScience runtime documentation. No network requests, packages, config changes, raw filesystem in REPL, resets or disposal. Shell/apply_patch is allowed ONLY to save your two assigned output files; no other filesystem reads. No implementation changes.
Discover actual project js tool via ALL_TOOLS. Verify cwd/project and cross-call persistence using a harmless binding in first two calls. Record each call code, raw returned content, elapsed wall ms measured in functions.exec with Date.now(), output UTF-8 bytes where available. Keep full results behind runtime handles. Native RDF/JS matching, N3 and Comunica only for evidence.
Budget per question: at most 12 js calls including discovery, data, maps, errors and final capture; at most 32768 output UTF-8 bytes aggregate (8192 estimated tokens at bytes/4), at most 4096 bytes for each bootstrap. Display no more than 10 rows/50 cells per observation. At most 5 minutes from first js call; stop earlier if answered. Reasoning/total model-token telemetry is unavailable: do not invent it. All generation/update/revalidation costs count. No free semantic preparation. Map ceiling 1024 estimated tokens; init using bootstrap({maxItems:16,maxBytes:4096}) once, subsequent bootstraps omit maxItems. Don't pad control.
Open var ws=linkedScience.open({contextKey:CONTEXT_KEY,orientationContext:{id:ORIENTATION_ID,version:'v1'}}). Start empty. Load supplied Turtle with ws.graphs.load({name:'data-source',kind:'instance-data',text:DATA,source:SOURCE}); source identity/version and fixture order must remain unchanged.
Treatment parameter enrich=false: automatic metadata only, no semantic edits. enrich=true: during ordinary inspection autonomously generate useful concise transferable relationship/meaning proposals (not target answers or task instructions), using ws.orientation.update({edits:[{action:'ADD',id:'ls-semantic:...',entry:{section:'context-understanding',claimKind:'observed-relationship',text:YOUR_TEXT,evidence:[{handle:graph,quads:NATIVE_OBSERVED_QUADS}]}}]}). Max 4 edits, 8 quads each; no manually fabricated evidence. Keep proposals small enough for 1024 token map ceiling; eviction/null result is valid, do not tune implementation. Citation validation is not semantic truth.
Before returning, capture JSON.stringify(await ws.orientation.current({maxBytes:8192})) as a map-only file at MAP_PATH (unchanged map; no answer/history). Capture a separate receipt at RECEIPT_PATH containing data version, final evidence-scoped answer, generated text, all exact js calls/raw outputs, counts of inspections/queries/updates and observed quads, errors/repairs/evictions, output bytes, call wall ms, missing model token/time telemetry. Do not expose full bulk data beyond the bounded fixture. Use apply_patch via functions tools to write exact JSON from captured responses, no shell interpolation. Parent handles registry/validation; leave runtime resident. Report the two file paths and concise outcome. Do not read any other files.

uni.warm: What entities and relationships connect the supplied protein entry to a reaction identifier? State only what this historical fragment establishes.
uni.follow: Does the supplied fragment establish a direct protein-to-reaction statement, and does it establish the reaction equation or participants? Explain the attribution and limits using evidence.

lib.warm: Which people are associated with the Harbor edition in the supplied catalog, and through what relationships?
lib.follow: Does this catalog assert that Tomas created Salt Roads, or that the Inland edition has a translator? Distinguish stated relationships, indirect associations, and unsupported claims.

transfer: Unchanged generated map-only JSON via existing peek.begin/edit; bootstrap before independently loading original data. Old epochs/context preserved. Same steps in both arms; transfer counted. No prior answer/chat passed.
model: Inherited parent model and reasoning settings for every fork_turns=none worker; no overrides
budgetLimitation: Model total token cap not exposed; matched instructed call/time/observation limits, not a verified matched total-token comparison.
repetition: One paired sequence per context; reversed-order repetition only if first pair warrants comparative claim. No outcome tuning.
staleness: After follow-up evidence capture, supply library v2 changing translator person9 to person4 and person9 label Tomas to person4 label Leena, with same source ID. Separate diagnostic costs and result; no changes to main pair.
reset: Only after registered pre-reset receipts; stale handles and historical map are not residency.
privateMaterial: Excluded; supplied historical development fragment and synthetic fixture only
